blurb: THE LINES WE CROSS: 250 Years of Maryland Forging America” July 31, 2026 - October 31, 2027 Maryland sits directly below the Mason-Dixon Line, a border state where freedom and slavery once existed side by side. In this landscape of impossible boundaries, Black Marylanders learned to navigate through movement, making, and profound creativity.
